mechanism: Both drugs compete for renal tubular secretion via urate transporters (URAT1), with pyrazinamide and its metabolite allantoin inhibiting uric acid excretion while febuxostat lowers uric acid production, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels closely during concurrent use; pyrazinamide may antagonize febuxostat's therapeutic efficacy and increase gout attack risk; consider alternative tuberculosis regimen if clinically feasible.
